logo.description: Minimalist fern leaf on white background for brand logo

login_background.description: Aerial view of a dense forest with autumn foliage

icons.usage: Use icons sparsely. Default stroke-width 1.5 for a sophisticated look.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Control Room Grid' for the dashboard (dense, clear, cardless or 1px border with no heavy drop shadows).
Never use generic 'SaaS blue'. Rely on Moss Green, Charcoal, and Off-White.
Implement full authentication flow (Login/Signup, Google Auth).
Dashboard must display overview stats: total alerts, forest area monitored, deforestation rate, recent activity.
Interactive map (Leaflet) must use severity colors (low, medium, high, critical) defined in the palette.
Map controls/overlays should use 'Crystal Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-white/80, 1px white border).
Include placeholder cards for Data Ingestion, Scraping, Satellite, Alerting, Analytics, AI Predictions as 'Coming Soon'.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
File extensions are .js, not .tsx. Use standard Shadcn UI components for complex logic but customize their styles to match the guidelines.
